description: The pie chart represents the distribution of various categories, with 12 distinct slices shown. The categories and their corresponding approximate percentages are: AI/NLP Research (24.3%, blue), Econ. & Fin. (18.4%, teal), Game&Anime (8.2%, orange), History (8.2%, yellow), Daily Life (7.1%, light green), Med & Health (6.7%, green), Science (6.7%, light blue), Business (5.9%, red), Pet & Animal (5.5%, dark orange), Law (5.1%, pink), Geography (2.7%, brown), and Math (1.2%, dark green). The chart includes percentage labels outside the slices, connected to their respective categories by lines, and does not have a legend. The slices are not visually emphasized or ordered in a particular way.
